channels.name: Open25-DM32 Classic
channels.description: RadioFoundry UI · DMR, FM and conventional P25

releases.notes: Coordinated Classic firmware and CPS release using RadioFoundry RFKV programming. Earlier Classic programming is not imported; choose Start new and recreate programming in the current Classic CPS. Includes current Classic identity and light-theme defaults, saved-channel refresh and NRFB hardware support. The application-only package uses the radio’s own DMR codec and preserves the bootloader and data chip during flashing. Full host software, sanitizer, target stack/ABI, warning and identical forced-rebuild checks passed. Physical-radio qualification of this new-format release has not been performed. Known issues: PL/CTCSS can drop during DTMF, and an intermittent P25 PTT startup with no RF remains under investigation. Save a full backup before installing.
